wins.label: Record Net Inflows
wins.evidence: Generated $221 billion of net inflows, our highest net flows quarter ever.

wins.label: Significant Margin Expansion
wins.evidence: Expanded our margin by 350 basis points year-over-year.

wins.label: High Organic Base Fee Growth
wins.evidence: Delivered 5% annualized organic base fee growth, our highest quarter in 3 years.

wins.label: Aladdin Technology Momentum
wins.evidence: Aladdin logs 15% ACV growth, consistent with our long-term low to mid-teens target with excellent momentum and key wins with growing clients.

wins.label: GIP Acquisition Impact
wins.evidence: Closing of GIP added $116 billion of client AUM and $70 billion of fee-paying AUM on October 1.

risks.label: Market Volatility
risks.evidence: BlackRock's actual results may, of course, differ from these statements. BlackRock has filed reports with the SEC, which list some of the factors that may cause the results of BlackRock to differ materially from what we say today.

risks.label: Regulatory Uncertainty
risks.evidence: There are -- it is not uncommon to see big, large changes in the marketplace. Rob Kapito talks about this a lot.

risks.label: Interest Rate Risk
risks.evidence: Fixed income delivered across the platform with over $60 billion of net inflows. We believe the continued path of central bank normalization will support sustained inflows across bond funds, ETFs and institutional accounts.

risks.label: Technology Risks
risks.evidence: Quarterly technology services revenue was down 1% compared to a year ago due to the prior year quarter revenue impact of eFront on-premises license renewals for several large clients.

risks.label: Private Market Volatility
risks.evidence: Private markets are a strategic priority for BlackRock, delivering world-class private markets capabilities to more deeply serve clients across the whole portfolio.
